A food critic game

Review Rush

Use better, the best, worse and the worst.

You are a food critic. Write your reviews before time runs out!

good→better→the best bad→worse→the worst

Pictures made for this classroom game. For classroom English practice.

How to play

1

Look at the stars

A 5-star dish is better than a 3-star dish. A 1-star dish is the worst of three. Stars never lie!

2

Finish the review

First, tap better or worse. Next, stamp the best or the worst on the right card.

3

Fix the mistakes

Watch out for words like gooder, badder, more better and worst than. Tap the mistake and pick the right word.

You have 3 lives. Be quick — the timer gets faster! You can pause at any time.
